coverage: All 1592 pages rendered and screened in 25 page-overview sheets. 92 figure-bearing pages additionally reviewed in 8 larger figure sheets. Selected anomalies and corrected pages inspected individually. This is a layout screening with targeted closer review, not line-by-line full-resolution reading of every page or a complete mathematical audit.
sparse_page_interpretation: Front-matter continuation/short convention page and part dividers account for the sparse pages except page 966, a heading-only content page.

issues.finding: The retained problem box asserts uniform convergence on [r,1) under bounded partial sums and uses necessity-like wording for sum n|a_n|. The solution on the next page already correctly rejects both claims.
issues.evidence: current/part2_slice.tex, repository lines 38420-38543; rendered detail_563.png and detail_564.png.
issues.counterexample: a_n=(-1)^n has bounded partial sums, but sup_{x in [r,1)} |a_n x^n|=1 for every n, so the necessary uniform term condition fails.
issues.proposed_resolution: In the box assert uniform convergence only on [0,r] (or compact subsets of (-1,1)); state sum n|a_n|<infinity as a sufficient condition for uniform absolute convergence of the derivative on |x|<=1, not a necessary condition. Preserve or explicitly annotate the historical source wording in provenance. The existing solution already supplies the correct qualification.

issues.finding: VI/16 heading occupies a page alone; the body starts on the next page.
issues.proposed_resolution: Inspect the first input after the VI/16 heading and keep the heading with initial body text; do not remove mathematical content. Rebuild and inspect both adjacent pages.
